description: This file contains functions and methods related to item details, pricing, stock, and inventory management within the ERPNext system, including retrieval and calculation of item rates, stock quantities, serial numbers, and tax templates.

methods.name: get_item_details
methods.description: Main function to retrieve detailed item information, including pricing, stock, tax, and related data, based on provided arguments and context.

methods.name: update_stock
methods.description: Updates stock and serial number details for delivery, sales invoice, or purchase order contexts.

methods.name: set_valuation_rate
methods.description: Calculates and sets the valuation rate for an item, considering product bundles.

methods.name: process_args
methods.description: Processes and normalizes input arguments, including parsing JSON strings and setting default values.

methods.name: process_string_args
methods.description: Converts string arguments to JSON if necessary.

methods.name: get_item_code
methods.description: Retrieves item code based on barcode or serial number.

methods.name: validate_item_details
methods.description: Validates item details such as company, end-of-life status, and variant status.

methods.name: get_basic_details
methods.description: Constructs basic item details including defaults, warehouse, accounts, and other attributes.

methods.name: get_item_warehouse
methods.description: Determines the appropriate warehouse for an item based on defaults and arguments.

methods.name: update_barcode_value
methods.description: Updates barcode value if only one barcode exists for the item.

methods.name: get_barcode_data
methods.description: Fetches barcode data for a list of items.

methods.name: get_item_tax_info
methods.description: Retrieves tax information for multiple items.

methods.name: _get_item_tax_template
methods.description: Selects the appropriate tax template based on validity and hierarchy.

methods.name: is_within_valid_range
methods.description: Checks if a tax rate falls within its valid range.

methods.name: get_item_tax_map
methods.description: Returns a mapping of tax types to rates for a given tax template.

methods.name: calculate_service_end_date
methods.description: Calculates deferred revenue or expense end dates based on item and transaction details.

methods.name: get_default_income_account
methods.description: Determines default income account for an item.

methods.name: get_default_expense_account
methods.description: Determines default expense account for an item.

methods.name: get_default_discount_account
methods.description: Returns default discount account for an item.

methods.name: get_default_deferred_account
methods.description: Returns default deferred revenue or expense account.

methods.name: get_default_cost_center
methods.description: Determines default cost center based on project, customer, or item defaults.

methods.name: get_default_supplier
methods.description: Returns default supplier for an item.

methods.name: get_price_list_rate
methods.description: Calculates the price list rate for an item based on various conditions.

methods.name: insert_item_price
methods.description: Inserts or updates item price in the database if missing or outdated.

methods.name: get_item_price
methods.description: Retrieves the item price considering quantity, UOM, and validity.

methods.name: check_packing_list
methods.description: Checks if desired quantity aligns with packing unit increments.

methods.name: validate_conversion_rate
methods.description: Validates and sets currency conversion rates.

methods.name: get_party_item_code
methods.description: Retrieves customer or supplier item code based on transaction type.

methods.name: get_pos_profile_item_details
methods.description: Fetches POS profile details for item transactions.

methods.name: get_pos_profile
methods.description: Retrieves POS profile document based on user and company.

methods.name: get_serial_nos_by_fifo
methods.description: Gets serial numbers ordered FIFO for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: get_serial_no_batchwise
methods.description: Gets serial numbers batch-wise FIFO for an item.

methods.name: get_conversion_factor
methods.description: Calculates UOM conversion factor for an item.

methods.name: get_projected_qty
methods.description: Returns projected quantity for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: get_bin_details
methods.description: Fetches stock bin details for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: get_company_total_stock
methods.description: Calculates total stock for an item across all warehouses of a company.

methods.name: get_serial_no_details
methods.description: Provides serial number details for an item.

methods.name: get_bin_details_and_serial_nos
methods.description: Fetches bin details along with serial number info.

methods.name: get_batch_qty_and_serial_no
methods.description: Gets batch quantity and serial number for an item.

methods.name: get_batch_qty
methods.description: Returns batch quantity for a batch number.

methods.name: apply_price_list
methods.description: Applies price list to a document or list of items, updating rates accordingly.

methods.name: apply_price_list_on_item
methods.description: Applies price list to a single item.

methods.name: get_price_list_currency_and_exchange_rate
methods.description: Fetches currency and exchange rate info for a price list.

methods.name: get_default_bom
methods.description: Retrieves default BOM for an item.

methods.name: get_valuation_rate
methods.description: Calculates valuation rate for an item based on stock or purchase invoice data.

methods.name: get_gross_profit
methods.description: Calculates gross profit based on valuation rate and base rate.
